_notes: 749 keys had no Spanish (cur = null); all are translated here. Register: consistent tú for the Student app and the Student native app; agency strings keep the tú the existing corpus uses (mobile:agency.login.tagline), university strings use usted (as mobile:v26.uni.head.label already does). Shared staff strings (mobile:v29.mfa.*) are written without a pronoun so they read the same in both consoles.

Dialect: the corpus is Spain-leaning but neutral enough (visado ×274, móvil ×31, matrícula ×131, plaza ×38); those are kept. Vosotros forms were removed (student:documents.privacy.short 'podéis' → 'pueden'); 'celular' (one stray) → 'teléfono'; 'recogida de datos' → 'recopilación'; 'Hacer una foto' avoided ('Tomar una foto'). 'Ajustes' → 'Configuración' in the two consent strings, matching student:settings.title.

Gender-neutral when the student is addressed: 'Bienvenido' → 'Te damos la bienvenida', 'Graduado' → 'Ya me gradué', 'Yo mismo' → 'Yo', 'Admitido' → 'Tienes la admisión', 'ENROLLED' → 'Tu matrícula está hecha'. Staff-facing cohort/filter labels (Admitidos, Graduados, Matriculados) stay in the generic plural.

Glossary alignment: consultation = consulta (mobile:v29.plan.supportUntil 'Asesoría' and student:v17.upgrade.feature.consultation 'Asesoría' moved); visa document preparation = 'preparación de los documentos del visado' (student:v15.services.scope.visa_support / v17.gate.what.visa said 'preparación del visado', which reads as Hangyul preparing the visa); managed application = 'Solicitudes que gestionamos contigo' (corpus majority, 3:1); mock interview unified on 'entrevista simulada' inside this job — success.json still says 'entrevista de práctica' (out of scope, owner to decide); personal statement = 'declaración personal' (corpus), editing = 'corrección'; transcript = 'expediente académico'; intake = 'convocatoria'; standard admission letter = 'carta de admisión estándar' (added where the English names it: v22.home.appTeam.letter, v3.appStatus.ADMISSION_CERTIFICATE_PENDING, v3.offer.step.letter).

Team identity: every remaining 'tu asesor' / 'un asesor real' in student-facing copy is now 'el equipo de Hangyul' (v3.home.nextBody.ESSAY_WRITE, v4.home.item.WRITE_ESSAY.text, v4.application.reviewLate, v4.application.writeOnWeb, student:login.aside.point3). 'Asesor' is kept only in staff strings where the English keeps 'counselor'.

No-promise back-check: student:v17.gate.named 'Hangyul se encarga de {{what}}' (Hangyul takes care of your applications) → 'Los planes incluyen {{what}}'; student:v15.services.scope.personal_roadmap 'Plan de estudios personalizado' collided with the study-plan essay → 'hoja de ruta personal'; v3.home.noCounselor dropped the invented 'plan de apoyo'.

mobile:v3.documents.howTo / v3.reviews.check.legal: {{path}} is 'apostilla' or 'legalización consular' (both feminine), so 'la {{path}}' is safe. v4.home.item.RENEW.title avoids an article before {{label}} (unknown gender): 'Renueva tu {{label}}'.
mobile:student.nextAction.FINISH_APPLICATION keeps the existing 'Quedan {{remaining}} elementos' — correct only if {{remaining}} is a number; if it can be text the owner should confirm.
mobile:v3.agency.waitingOn.us / view.waiting_us ('Waiting for us'): rendered 'Nos toca a nosotros' because 'Esperando a nosotros' is not Spanish.
